differences.openwhisper: OpenWhisper can restart its MCP listener when a stored preference is enabled.
differences.fiorivoce: Starting a desktop listener requires confirmation of its loopback address and access. Its switch reflects whether the current session is running.
differences.reason: Reviewing access at start lets a user choose when local assistants can read saved text or change selected preferences.

differences.openwhisper: The upstream MCP server can bind directly to a Tailscale interface.
differences.fiorivoce: The desktop session listens on loopback. A separate paired-session workflow can start a temporary read-only loopback server on the host. A host can stop that session at any time.
differences.reason: Local desktop access and permission granted to a paired operator have separate audiences and lifetimes.

differences.openwhisper: The desktop MCP server offers the live tools (get_live_state, list_actions, run_action, start/stop/cancel_dictation, recent_events, notify_user) behind the API & MCP permissions, reports those permissions in get_capabilities, and serves MCP Events (events/list, subscribe, unsubscribe and signed deliveries to subscribers' URLs).
differences.fiorivoce: The local MCP session is built with allow_live_tools=false: it lists and runs only the history and control tools, its instructions say it reads saved dictations and meetings, get_capabilities reports every live permission and mcp_events as false, and no agentapi::McpEvents is built, so events/* and deliveries are not offered (the API & MCP page reads 'MCP is not available in this session' for its Events controls). The live tools and McpEvents are complete and tested on their own.
differences.reason: The local MCP session serves saved content; its tool list excludes live dictation text, microphone control and action requests, and nothing sends events to external URLs unattended.
differences.source: src/ui_automation/session_mcp.cpp (deps.allow_live_tools = false), src/agentapi/mcp_tools.cpp McpTools::listed/instructions, src/agentapi/agent_controls.cpp capabilities; tests/agentapi/test_mcp_protocol.cpp ('desktop history session excludes live tools even when live permissions were saved'); docs/port/open-items.md summary ('The local MCP session serves saved content ... Its tool list excludes live dictation text, microphone control and action requests')

differences.openwhisper: The History API and MCP history tools merge paired clients' history into pages with include_clients / device_id (parallel fetch, server-side clients- cursors, per-client status).
differences.fiorivoce: No server is given a client history source, so include_clients and device_id read only this computer's database; a paired client's recent history is viewed instead in an explicitly opened, time-limited session (ui_remote's client history dialog). FederatedHistory exists and is tested on its own.
differences.reason: Time and record limits bound the data a live pairing exposes; matches the decision recorded as a17-direct-history.
differences.source: docs/port/differences.md a17-direct-history (docs/port/map/a17-remote-engine-services.md, A17-52); src/agentapi/history_routes.cpp HistoryApi (federation only with a ClientHistorySource), src/ui_remote/client_history_dialog.cpp

differences.openwhisper: A paired client can read and configure the host's MCP (enabled, port, Tailscale, write grants) through host_control's state() and configure().
differences.fiorivoce: A host grants one paired connection a read-only local listener for 15 minutes; the peer cannot change the host's MCP settings, and the token is shown on the host only.
differences.reason: Granting access to one paired device does not authorize changes to the host's usual settings; matches the decision recorded as a17-paired-mcp.
